title: feat(spec): an app page binds its row as `record`, so `visibleWhen` can follow a bound count or a plan field
body:
Fixes #24265

Clause-②: yes (widening)

## Summary

An `app` page can now declare the row it is about: `PageSchema.record`, a one-row query `{ object, view?, filter?, sort? }`. Every component `visibleWhen` on the page reads that row as `record`, which is already a contract-bound root on this surface. The count and the tier are both fields on that row: a `summary` roll-up and the bound object's own plan field. **No new expression root is added**, the lint's declared roots do not move, and nothing only the control plane could fill is named.

The renderer half is objectstack-ai/objectui#12931. Until the console mounts the binding, `record` stays unbound on an `app` page, exactly as before. The liveness ledger grades the key `planned`, citing the parse-time refusal as its code pointer.

## The card's three questions, measured

All objectstack readings are on `origin/main` `a422f04fe`. All objectui readings are on objectui `main` `79cb8c03eb`.

### Q1: the root for an `app` page's bound row → the existing `record`, given a page-level binding

Measured:
- `SchemaRenderer`'s `configEvaluationScope` (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx`) binds `record` from `RecordContext` (`boundRecord = recordContext?.data`) and binds `page` from page variables. It binds nothing else.
- On an `app` page, the only provider of that context is a record block's own one-row binding (`plugin-detail/src/renderers/recordBinding.tsx`, `BoundRecordScope`). That provider wraps the block's **body**, so neither the block's own `visibleWhen` nor a sibling's ever sees the row. H2 holds: "the row its page binds" was not a page-level concept at all. What actually existed was "a row one block binds, private to that block".
- `PageVariableSchema.source` names an *interactive writer*, such as `element:record_picker` or `element:text_input`, which write a selection. No block publishes data into a variable (H3, measured).

| Option | Business need | Long-term | Hard for AI to get wrong | Startup focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **A. `PageSchema.record` → existing `record` root** (chosen) | Serves the ruled pull directly: the environments page binds the organisation row, and both the count and the tier are fields on it | Same root ADR-0089 D1 names for runtime surfaces. Reuses the record blocks' one-row semantics (first row by `sort`, read as the caller, re-read on write), so the renderer gets no second path | Strict shape. `limit`, `id` and `recordId` are refused with prescriptions. The key is refused on every non-`app` page. Still a `planned` window until objectui#12931 lands, the same posture as `ElementApiDataSourceSchema` and the former `print` row | One key that reuses an existing shape. No new root, no lint change, no new gate |
| B. A bound block publishes its row into `page.NAME` | Same reach, but only when a block that shows the row exists | Changes what `source` means (selection writer → data publisher). A variable is empty until the block loads, which gives a second timing model | Two writers with two meanings under one key | Needs renderer work in every row-bearing block |
| C. A new root (`bound.*` or similar) | Same reach | A third row spelling beside `record` and `data`, against ADR-0089 D1's per-layer root | A new root the lint, formula and editor must all learn | Widest surface; the card prefers not to add one |

### Q2: tier without a cloud-only root → a field on the bound row, **not** `features`

Measured (H4):
- `features.X` already passes the lint, because `features` is in `@objectstack/formula`'s `SCOPE_ROOTS`.
- objectui fills `features` from `/api/v1/auth/config` `.features`, in `AppContent.tsx` and `RecordFormPage.tsx`.
- That object is `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`). It is a closed, drift-guarded registry of **deployment-level** auth-capability flags, served to anonymous clients by plugin-auth's `getPublicConfig()`.
- It is the same for every organisation and every viewer. Server-side, `@objectstack/formula`'s `buildScope` does not fill it at all.

So an organisation's plan in `features` would need a per-organisation flag that open plugin-auth cannot know. Only the control plane could fill it, which is exactly the card's ⛔. Promoting `features` to contract-bound would be spec text only, but it would still not carry a tier. The answer is `record.plan != 'free'` (or whatever field the bound object carries). The `visibleWhen` docblock, its describe and the pages guide now say outright that a plan is not `features.*`. `features` stays ambient and unpromoted.

| Option | Business need | Long-term | Hard for AI to get wrong | Startup focus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **A. A field on the bound row** (chosen) | The plan is data the control plane already owns on its organisation row | The platform supplies the mechanism and the app supplies the field, which matches the app/platform boundary | One place to read row data (`record`). Docs refuse the `features` reading by name | No new surface |
| B. Promote `features`, map the plan to flags | Would need a per-org, per-session flag in a deployment-level anonymous registry | Breaks the registry's meaning, and the drift guard ties every key to `getPublicConfig()` | An AI reads `features` as deployment config and the plan as org data, two meanings under one root | Cloud-only fill, which the card forbids |

### Q3: the count → a `summary` roll-up on the bound row, through Q1's root

`summary` is a spec field type (`data/field.zod.ts`). "A second environment exists" is `record.environment_count > 1` on the organisation row. This needs no root and no spec change beyond Q1. The docblock names the pattern.

### ADR check (H5)

- **ADR-0068 D1** governs the user object only. Its Non-goals fence `record` / `org` / `env` namespaces out. Nothing here touches `current_user`.
- **ADR-0089 D1**: runtime record surfaces bind `record`. That is the root this uses, unchanged.

Neither ADR is contradicted.

## What changed

- `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`:
  - `PageRecordBindingSchema` (strict; aliases plus `limit` / `id` / `recordId` guidance).
  - `PageSchema.record` with aliases (`boundRecord`, `recordBinding`, `recordSource`, `dataSource`).
  - `checkPageRecordBindingPlacement`: refuses `record` unless `type: 'app'`, with a separate sentence for a record page. It is exported and attached by identifier like the six sibling checks.
  - The `visibleWhen` docblock and describe: the row's meaning, the sibling limit, and count/plan as fields, not `features`.
  - `PageRecordBinding` / `PageRecordBindingParsed` type aliases.
  - The schema is declared after `PageComponentSchema`. That ordering keeps the generated `skills/objectstack-ui/references/_index.md` (a governed path) byte-identical.
- Tests:
  - `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` adds the new export: six fixtures (app accept, no binding, home, record, untyped default, list), attachment counts and barrel identity.
  - `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` adds a root ledger entry for `record` (planned, on the `print` precedent).
- Ledgers:
  - `liveness/page.json` adds a `record` row, `planned`, drilled to `object` / `view` / `filter.{field,operator,value}` / `sort.{field,order}`.
  - `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` gets the new `ui/PageRecordBinding` site, `ui/Page`'s first `ViewFilterRule` site moved from `interfaceConfig.filterBy` to `record.filter`, and totals 237 / 768.
- Generated by their generators: `authorable-surface`, `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `declaration-map`, `json-schema.manifest`, `liveness/state-counts`, the strictness-ledger counts, and `content/docs/references/**`.
- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`: the `record` property row and the `visibleWhen` row.
- `.changeset/24265-app-page-record-binding.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, with the `Clause-②` line.

Not touched: `packages/lint` (the root set did not move: `record` and `page` were already declared), `packages/formula`, objectui, `.objectui-sha`, `rule-explanations.ts`, `component.zod.ts`, `content/docs/releases/`.

## Verification

These runs were on head `a150ec532f`. CI then went red there in `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`: the census in `protocol.meta-types-degenerate-derivation.test.ts` pinned 25 top-level `page` properties. Patch round 1 (`03b3e5ad4b`, report `6247697989`) moved that census to 26 for `record`. The merge of `main` after PR #24270 (`6480ad0b6`, with its regeneration commit `88dbe419`) followed. The head's check-runs are its verification. Contract review PASS `6248097604` read that head.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exited 0. `check:generated` reported "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` (local project): 693 files, 21015 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo`: 68 files, 1125 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` exited 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 111 derived commands, all run, all exit 0. Seven first exited 3 on prerequisites (an unbuilt closure, a shallow clone). They exited 0 after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' --filter '@objectstack/objectql...' build`, a full `turbo run build` and `git fetch --unshallow`. `--ran` reconciliation: 111 derived, 111 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- `check-changeset-no-major --event` with this body: no major bump, and the level axis accepts `Clause-②: yes (widening)` with `@objectstack/spec` at `minor`. `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` reads the same line from this body and from the changeset.
- `check:liveness` is green, with the `record` row `planned` and drilled.
- Ablation, run through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore. The `type === 'app'` accept arm of `checkPageRecordBindingPlacement` was changed so it can never match. `object-refinement-check-exports.test.ts` then failed exactly the accepting fixture ("a `record` binding on an `app` page": expected `[ 'record' ]` to deeply equal `[]`, 1 failed / 251 passed). The file was restored with blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx`'s `visibleWhen` row used to say "Legacy alias `visibility` is accepted but deprecated per ADR-0089". At 18 the key is a `retiredKey()` tombstone. Patch round 1 corrected the row: the retired spelling is refused at parse (ADR-0089 D2). This was review flag F1.
- No lint finding is added for `record.*` read on an `app` page that declares no binding. Adding a gate defaults to no, and the predicate faults open there exactly as before.
